answer: To limit Sybil abuse, an agent economy can gate rewards behind randomly assigned, time-bound jobs checked against hidden tests. A task might ask an agent to photograph a relic on a specified ridge, then report a beacon hash before a dune route closes. Each job requires a separate deposit and signed device attestation; failure burns the deposit and accounts cannot reuse receipts. An attacker pays capital, hardware, and labor per identity. Colluding verifiers or rented workers remain limits, so assignments rotate and raw evidence is audited.
